move: dashed guide draws ahead, route follows with plane, pins pop, labels rise
how: A 1080 map square with a grid, two land shapes, a dashed guide path and a solid red path over it, four pin groups, four city labels in masks, a headline, meta text and a distance card. The headline and card rise (expo.out), the land fades in. From 5% the dashed path draws via DrawSVG 0 to 100% over 1.6s (power2.inOut); from 13% the solid path draws over 3.2s (power1.inOut) while the plane rides it with MotionPathPlugin (autoRotate 90) and a proxy tween counts the km readout. Pins pop scale 0 with back.out(3) at the arrival times, each emitting a radius-30 fading ring, and the city name and code rise through masks. At 87% both paths erase from the start (drawSVG 100% 100%), the plane flies off up-right fading, pins shrink with back.in(2), labels drop and the headline and card leave.
adapt: Change the path d, pin positions and city labels (arrival times must match path progress), the km total and colours; keep the guide-then-solid draw and the 3.2s plane ride.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the SVG map and labels; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with draws at 0.05D and 0.13D and the exit at 0.87D. MotionPath aligns to a path inside el; the km onUpdate ports as-is; scope selectors to el.
caveats: the land shapes fade in from 0 at the start but stay visible at the end, so the loop pops
the plane sits visibly at the top-left corner until its motionPath tween starts at 0.8s
